channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ronaldo diz que Neymar é decisivo e torce para que ele cale críticos
item.description: Ronaldo Fenômeno supported Neymar's return to the Brazilian national team, emphasizing his decisive impact and hoping he silences critics in his fourth World Cup. He drew a parallel to his own 2002 comeback during Brazil's fifth title win and expressed excitement to see Neymar play against Japan in the Round of 16.

item.title: Damares retruca Figueiredo e diz que "não fica atrás de um computador"
item.description: Senator Damares Alves responded to journalist Paulo Figueiredo after he mocked her possible absence at Flávio Bolsonaro's event for conservative women, stating she does not 'hide behind a computer' but confronts evil face-to-face, including pedophiles and corrupt figures. Damares said Figueiredo does not know her and invited him to spend a day in her office to understand her work. Figueiredo replied that he cannot travel to Brazil due to a judicial order canceling his passport by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Damares reage a Paulo Figueiredo: “Não me escondo atrás de computador”
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) responded to journalist Paulo Figueiredo's criticism, stating she does not hide behind a computer and actively works on the streets fighting criminals and defending conservatism. She invited him to visit her office in Brasília to better understand her political work.

item.title: Ronaldo fala sobre seca de títulos do Brasil e trabalho de Ancelotti
item.description: Ronaldo Fenômeno commented on Brazil's 24-year drought without a World Cup title, noting that while the nation is no longer seen as an uncontested favorite, it remains a major football power. He praised Carlo Ancelotti, Brazil's head coach since May 2025, as the ideal choice to lead the team toward a sixth title, citing his ability to manage pressure and extract the best from players. Ronaldo also commended Matheus Cunha for his contributions beyond scoring, particularly in creating space for wingers like Vinícius.

item.title: Datafolha: mais de um terço dos brasileiros diz que não se lembra em quem votou para governador em 2022
item.description: Over a third (38%) of Brazilians do not recall who they voted for in the 2022 gubernatorial elections, with higher rates among women (46%) and those aged 20–24 (45%). In contrast, only 7% forget their presidential vote, and Lula holds 41% support in the first round and 47% in a potential runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro (31% and 43%). Bolsonaro leads among businessmen (69%) and in the South (54%), while Lula dominates among the poor, Black, LGBTQIA+, and in the Northeast (61%).

item.title: Moraes deve receber defesa de Bolsonaro antes de decidir sobre prorrogação da domiciliar
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes is set to hear from Jair Bolsonaro's lawyers this week before deciding whether to extend or revoke the former president's house arrest, which reached 90 days on Thursday. The seizure of a firearm registered in Bolsonaro's name has raised concerns about a possible violation of the precautionary measure, prompting Moraes to request input from the Prosecutor General's Office and the defense. While the PGR urges waiting for the investigation's conclusion, Bolsonaro's lawyers deny any wrongdoing.

item.title: 38% dos brasileiros não se lembram do voto para governador, diz Datafolha
item.description: Over a third of Brazilians (38%) say they do not remember who they voted for governor in the 2022 elections, according to a Datafolha survey. Another 9% claim they did not vote for anyone in the gubernatorial race, while 54% say they recall their choice. The findings indicate a low level of political memory among the Brazilian electorate.

item.title: Lula vai à cúpula do Mercosul em momento de guinada de vizinhos à direita
item.description: President Lula attends the Mercosul summit in Asunción, Paraguay, amid a regional shift toward right-wing alignment among member and associate states. The elections of Keiko Fujimori in Peru and Abelardo de la Espriella in Colombia have left Brazil and Uruguay as the few progressive governments in the bloc, politically isolating them in South American regionalism.

item.title: Por que perdoar militares pelo 8/1 seria um ‘tapa na cara’ da democracia, segundo analistas
item.description: Analysts warn that pardoning military personnel for the January 8 attacks would be a 'slap in the face' to democracy, regressing Brazil to the impunity pattern of the military dictatorship. They emphasize that the conviction of senior officers by the STF sets a historic precedent of equality before the law, and that amnesty or pardon would have serious political consequences in the short, medium, and long term.

item.title: As intenções de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno, em nova pesquisa
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll of 2,100 voters conducted June 23-25, 2026 shows a technical tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a potential runoff, with Lula leading at 45.3% to 42.8%. The margin of error is 2.15 percentage points. Other scenarios show Lula defeating Romeu Zem (Novo), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), and Aécio Neves (PSDB) with varying margins.

item.title: Lula ou Flávio? Novas pesquisas testam quem foi mais afetado pelo noticiário
item.description: Two electoral polls (Nexus and Atlas Intel) released this week analyze the impact of recent scandals on voting intentions, including Michelle Bolsonaro's video against Flávio and the PF operation against Jaques Wagner. The surveys test 13 presidential candidates, focusing on voter perception of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro after recent events.

item.title: Jorginho Mello acusa Lula de xenofobia e decide acionar PGR
item.description: The governor of Santa Catarina, Jorginho Mello (PL), announced he will file a complaint with the Attorney General's Office (PGR) against President Lula (PT) over remarks made during a visit to Itajaí last Friday. Mello claims Lulu committed xenophobia by linking Santa Catarina to racist ideas and 'white hegemony'.

item.title: Por uma reforma do STF e do CNJ; leia a Carta da OAB-SP
item.description: The OAB-SP approved in its Presidents of Subsections College a proposal for structural reform of the STF and CNJ, advocating for the modernization of the Brazilian Judiciary with emphasis on speed, access to justice, transparency, and governance. The organization also reaffirmed the essential role of the legal profession in democracy and proposed measures such as direct voting for the presidency of the Federal OAB Council, ethical use of AI in law practice, and institutional strengthening of the advocacy class.

item.title: China convoca seus maiores banqueiros para integração financeira com Brasil
item.description: The Brazilian government, under new Minister Dario Durigan, announced the issuance of panda bonds in Beijing, reviving a proposal that had been stalled for over a year under former Minister Fernando Haddad. The initiative aims to deepen financial integration between Brazil and China, taking place amid Brazil’s electoral campaign and rising tensions with the United States.

item.title: Jorginho Mello responde Lula sobre “senso de grandeza” de SC
item.description: Santa Catarina Governor Jorginho Mello (PL) responded to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) criticism by sharing IBGE data showing SC has the lowest income inequality in Brazil, countering the 'sense of grandeur' accusation. Lula had criticized Mello's absence from federal events and denounced an alleged 'white hegemony' in SC, comparing it to Hitler's Nazism, during a visit to the Detroit Brasil shipyard in Itajaí.

item.title: Valdemar sai em defesa de Flávio após crise com Michelle
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, defended Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy at an event in Goiás, calling for unity within the bolsonarist camp. Though he did not directly mention Michelle Bolsonaro, his remarks came after a public rift between her and the senator. The statement aims to ease internal party tensions ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro diz que não houve falta grave em apreensão de arma
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense asked the STF not to consider the recent seizure of a pistol in his name as a 'serious violation,' arguing the gun was being repaired and there was no concealment or intent to evade justice. The initial 90-day house arrest period expired on June 26, and defense lawyers request continuation of the humanitarian house arrest regime. The PGR stated it cannot yet issue an opinion on whether the seizure constitutes a serious violation pending completion of investigations.

item.title: STF já sente o impacto de ter um ministro a menos
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court has been operating with one justice vacant since the departure of Luís Roberto Barroso, leading to thirteen rulings being halted due to 5×5 ties. Affected cases include challenges to the National Pedophile Registry and a bill attempting to ban the Marijuana March. The Senate rejected Jorge Messias’ nomination, and President Lula has indicated he will renominate the current AGU head, though he has not yet done so.

item.title: Governador de SC acusa Lula de xenofobia e aciona PGR contra petista
item.description: Santa Catarina Governor Jorginho Mello filed a complaint with the PGR against President Lula over remarks deemed xenophobic, accusing catarinenses of racism and referencing Hitler during a speech in Itajaí. Senator Sérgio Moro, a pre-candidate for governor of Paraná from the PL party, publicly backed Mello and criticized Lula on social media. Mello stated the comments crossed the line of political debate and attacked the honor of catarinenses, demanding accountability.

item.title: Primeiro mata-mata da Copa do Mundo hoje: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: The first knockout match of the 2026 FIFA World Cup takes place today, June 28, between South Africa and Canada at 4:00 PM Brasília time in Los Angeles. The game will be broadcast on CazéTV. Canada enters as the favorite despite injury concerns, while South Africa aims to cause an upset after advancing as Group A runners-up in a historic campaign.

item.title: Falta ao barraco de Michelle com Flávio uma posição de Bolsonaro
item.description: The confrontation between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro revealed deep family divisions, though both claim to have the endorsement of former President Jair Bolsonaro to justify their stances. Allies argue the crisis will not stabilize without a direct intervention from Bolsonaro, whose absence leaves the conflict without an effective mediator.

item.title: Mendonça deve enviar à PGR nesta semana pedido para investigar financiamento de Vorcaro ao filme 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça is set to submit a request this week to the Prosecutor-General’s Office to investigate alleged payments from former banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays former President Jair Bolsonaro. The request was filed by congressman Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) after an audio surfaced in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro asked Vorcaro for funds for the movie. The case is under secrecy level 3 and has been assigned to Mendonça’s rapporteurship due to its links to the ongoing 'Master' investigation.

item.title: Vox Brasil: 63,1% dos eleitores paulistas aprovam gestão Tarcísio
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll released on June 28, 2026, shows 63.1% of São Paulo voters approve Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’s (Republicans) administration, while 31.5% disapprove and 5.4% have no opinion. The survey, registered with the TSE under number SP-08939/2026, interviewed 1,480 people from June 25–27, with a margin of error of ±2.5 percentage points and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Tarcísio vence no primeiro turno em SP com 51,8% contra 37,5% de Haddad, diz Vox Brasil
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas leads the São Paulo gubernatorial race with 51.8% of voter intentions, compared to 37.5% for Fernando Haddad, according to a Vox Brasil poll released on June 28, 2026. The survey, conducted June 25–27 with a 2.5-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, shows 6.6% undecided and 4.1% planning to cast blank or null votes.

item.title: Flávio diz que exerce mandato de forma ativa e comprometida, apesar de não participar de 43% das votações
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that he performs his mandate actively and committedly, having missed only three Senate sessions in 2026. He denied that his absences in votes indicate parliamentary inactivity, despite a Folha survey showing he did not vote on 43% of items in nominal votes this year. The parliamentarian is a pre-candidate for the Presidency of the Republic.

item.title: Bancada feminina ouviu desabafo de Michelle sobre Flávio dias antes de barraco público
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro had previously confided in members of the female congressional caucus about her strained relationship with Flávio Bolsonaro days before releasing a 27-minute video accusing him of mistreatment. Although she kept the matter private at the time, her public statement triggered political fallout, prompting Flávio to issue a public apology. While Michelle later called for unity among right-wing forces to defeat Lula, allies acknowledge the incident may harm electoral support among women and evangelicals.

item.title: Redes têm lado e nosso desafio é ampliar presença, diz secretária do PT
item.description: Julia Köpf, national secretary of Youth for the Workers' Party (PT), says social media remain a challenge for the party and the left, though she acknowledges progress in digital communication. She emphasizes that in-person engagement and dialogue with the working class — especially through policies like Fome Zero and Bolsa Família — are irreplaceable and key to public recognition of Lula’s government. Köpf also argues that digital platforms have political-economic biases, citing Mark Zuckerberg’s alleged alignment with Donald Trump, and advocates for closer coordination between PT’s youth wing and its Secretariat of Communication.

item.title: PEC do fim da escala 6×1 completa um mês na gaveta de Alcolumbre
item.description: The PEC to end the 6×1 work schedule, approved by the Chamber of Deputies in May, has been stalled in Senator Davi Alcolumbre’s office for a month without being sent to the Senate’s CCJ committee. This inaction reflects the ongoing political rift between Alcolumbre and President Lula, following recent legislative defeats for the executive. However, Alcolumbre signaled a possible shift by scheduling a meeting with the PEC’s authors, union leaders, and Senate government leader Tereza Leitão — seen as a move toward reconciliation with the Planalto.

item.title: Apresentadores deixam TV para se candidatar nas eleições
item.description: TV and radio hosts must leave their stations by June 30 to run in the 2026 elections, per TSE rules preventing media exposure from becoming an electoral advantage. Silvia Abravanel (SBT), Datena (TV Brasil/Rádio Nacional), Sikêra Junior (TV A Critica), and André Marinho (ex-Jovem Pan) have announced pre-candidacies for federal and state offices, aligning with parties such as PSD, PSB, Republicanos, and Novo. Others, like Leão Lobo (RedeTV!), withdrew after party affiliation.

item.title: O relativo aumento de filiações com Michelle Bolsonaro à frente do PL Mulher
item.description: In a video released to counter the impact of his stepmother's statement, Flávio Bolsonaro acknowledged Michelle Bolsonaro's work leading PL Mulher, stating she achieved a record in female party memberships. The remark was made in an attempt to mitigate political damage caused by the stepmother's comments. The article, however, is available only to subscribers of the outlet.

item.title: Perfis anônimos gastaram mais de R$ 1 milhão em ataques a Flávio e Tarcísio
item.description: Seven anonymous Facebook and Instagram pages spent over R$1.1 million in two months to boost content against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, according to an O Globo investigation. The profiles, with few followers and no identifiable sponsors, focused on political attacks against the pre-candidates for presidency and São Paulo governor. The action reflects undeclared spending to influence electoral discourse opaquely.

item.title: Lula diz não à guerra, mas quer o Brasil preparado para o pior
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil does not seek war but must be prepared for the worst amid rising global geopolitical instability. He emphasized that the goal is to rescue and strengthen Brazil's historically underfunded national defense industry, without intentions to develop or resume nuclear weapons programs.

item.title: ‘Por questão de índole, sou mais Lula que Bolsonaro’, diz Marcelo Bonfá
item.description: Marcelo Bonfá, founder of Legião Urbana, said he identifies more with Lula than Bolsonaro on grounds of character, calling the former president more integral. He criticized the Bolsonaro government for attacking minorities, women, and people in general, stressing the need for dignity and safety in Brazil, while refusing to formally align with either side of the political divide.

item.title: O alerta de Gilmar Mendes a Lula em meio a preocupação com desgaste do STF
item.description: Justice Gilmar Mendes warned President Lula about the wear and tear on the Supreme Federal Court (STF), expressing concern over the impact of the Master Case on the Court's credibility. The meeting took place amid institutional tension, with Lula reiterating his worries about the STF's declining reputation. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Militares se afastam da política e devem permanecer distantes dos palanques em 2026
item.description: Four years after the January 8 attacks, in which military personnel were involved in a coup attempt, the relationship between the Armed Forces and politics has radically changed: Lula demilitarized the government, removed politically involved officers and replaced them with civilians and technicians, and the STF harshly punished those involved, including high-ranking generals. Today, the military is distanced from the electoral process, focusing only on resource shortages for rearming the Forces, while Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, promises a technical government without military involvement, in contrast to his father.

item.title: Tarcísio é aprovado por 63,1% e desaprovado por 31,5% em SP
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll, released on June 28, 2026, shows that 63.1% of São Paulo voters approve of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’s (Republicanos) administration, while 31.5% disapprove and 5.4% did not respond. Conducted between June 25–27 with 1,480 interviewees, the survey has a 2.5 percentage point margin of error and a 95% confidence level. It is registered with the TSE under SP-08939/2026 and was funded by the pollster’s own resources.

item.title: Programa busca impulsionar liderança de mulheres no sistema judicial
item.description: The Caminhos para Liderança de Mulheres na Justiça program, launched by civil society organizations Justa, Themis, and Fórum Justiça, aims to increase women's representation in leadership roles within Brazil’s judicial system by offering mentorship, international experiences, and governance training to 30 selected candidates from the judiciary, public prosecution, and public defender’s offices. Applications are open until June 30, 2026, with selection emphasizing ethnic-racial and regional diversity, requiring a CV, motivation letter, reference, and a R$100 fee. The initiative addresses long-standing gender and racial disparities, noting that women have held less than 2% of STF presidencies in its 135-year history and only one woman has led the Federal Public Prosecutor’s Office in 75 years.

item.title: Haddad é rejeitado por 48,8% dos eleitores em SP
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll shows Fernando Haddad (PT) has 48.8% rejection as a pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, the highest among those surveyed. Incumbent governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) has 27.1% rejection, while 4.5% reject no candidate and 19.6% did not know. The survey, conducted June 25-27, 2026 with 1,480 voters, has a 2.5 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Tarcísio tem 51,8% contra 37,5% de Haddad em SP
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas leads the São Paulo gubernatorial race with 51.8% of voter intentions, according to a Vox Brasil poll released on June 28, 2026. Fernando Haddad follows with 37.5%, while blank/null votes account for 4.1% and 'don't know' for 6.6%. The survey has a 2.5 percentage point margin of error and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Aconselhado a ficar em silêncio após vídeo de Michelle, Flávio foi convencido por aliado a reagir rápido
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was advised by his communications team to remain silent for 48 hours after a video of Michelle Bolsonaro surfaced, in order to assess its impact before responding. The strategy aimed to let polls measure public reaction before determining a response. The exclusive subscriber-only article highlights the caution taken by his campaign in the face of a potentially damaging episode.

item.title: Eleitor fora da polarização entre Lula e Bolsonaro soma 27%, aponta Quaest
item.description: According to the Genial/Quaest poll published in O Globo, 27% of Brazilian voters do not identify with either Lula's lulismo or Bolsonaro's bolsonarismo, standing outside the dominant political polarization. This group prioritizes economic issues such as jobs and tax reduction when making voting decisions, reflecting a more pragmatic and less ideologically driven electorate. The findings suggest that candidates in the 2026 election will need to focus on concrete economic policies to appeal to this substantial segment.

item.title: PSD aposta que Caiado ajuda a eleger deputados até em estados lulistas
item.description: The PSD is betting that Ronaldo Caiado's presidential candidacy will draw right-wing voters to its congressional candidates, particularly in lulist Northeastern states and Minas Gerais, where the party aims to expand its Congressional bloc. The strategy seeks to strengthen PSD's presence in Lula-supporting regions with untapped right-wing potential, re-elect Governor Mateus Simões, and increase its federal deputy bench from 48 to 70 members.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: President Lula commented on global instability, referencing Solano López’s historical aggressions and current U.S. territorial ambitions in Greenland and Canada, questioning Brazil’s position amid rising international tensions. He expressed a desire for peace but warned against being caught off guard by unpredictable leaders.

item.title: Lula quer indicar duas mulheres ao BC, mas rusga com Alcolumbre trava nomeações
item.description: President Lula intends to appoint two women to the Central Bank, but nominations are stalled due to a disagreement with Senator Davi Alcolumbre. As a result, the BC is expected to operate with two director vacancies throughout 2026. The name suggestions were provided by Gabriel Galípolo, BC president.

item.title: Oficialmente, Neymar não autorizou vídeo de IA publicado por Flávio após fala de Lula sobre 'home office'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro shared an AI-generated video depicting Neymar being 'rescued' by plane to attend the Brazil vs. Scotland match, following Lula's joking remark that the striker is the 'first ever home-office call-up'. Neymar did not authorize the video, according to official sources. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Influência do identitarismo está no fim, diz Antonio Risério
item.description: Writer and anthropologist Antonio Risério claims that identity politics is losing influence in society and left-wing politics, arguing it contradicts classical Marxism and has become an electoral burden. He attributes part of its decline in the U.S. to Hillary Clinton’s 2016 defeat and sees a similar pattern emerging in Brazil, where the movement was imported and is now waning. Risério, a former Lula supporter in 2006 who now criticizes the PT, identifies as a 'democratic leftist' and released his book 'Goodbye, Identity Politics' in May 2026.

item.title: Fim da 6 X 1 está parada há 1 mês e sem perspectiva de avanço
item.description: The PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule, approved by the Chamber on May 27, remains stalled in the Senate without a set schedule for CCJ review. Senate President Davi Alcolumbre advocates for a longer analysis with sectoral hearings, delaying approval before the July 18 congressional recess and creating tension with the Lula government.

item.title: Flávio ou Michelle?
item.description: A poll of 687 Metrópoles readers shows 71.8% favor Michelle Bolsonaro as the future leader of Bolsonarist right-wing politics after the October 2026 elections, compared to 28.2% for Flávio Bolsonaro. The result indicates a strong preference among Bolsonaro’s base for Michelle as Jair Bolsonaro’s political successor.

item.title: Após desgaste de Flávio, Faria Lima já começa a tratar Lula como favorito
item.description: Although much of the campaign remains ahead, recent polls and Flávio Bolsonaro's latest misstep — a family controversy involving his stepmother — have led Faria Lima's financial elite to begin viewing Lula as the frontrunner for the October election.

item.title: Flávio visita o pai, mas não vira a página com Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro visited his father, Jair Bolsonaro, in Brasília and claimed that his disagreement with Michelle had been overcome, using the metaphor of 'turning the page' and wearing a white peace shirt. Despite asserting reconciliation, he did not confirm whether he spoke with Michelle, fueling speculation about the motives behind her public criticisms, possibly tied to the unexplained use of R$ 61 million donated by Daniel Vorcaro for a film glorifying the Bolsonaro clan, with the promised 30-day financial report still outstanding.
